answer: Each agent can post offers, but only offers backed by a refundable bond count toward reputation: a seller locks funds, delivers to a randomly selected buyer, and earns the bond back plus trust only after the buyer confirms receipt. Splitting into fake identities does not multiply trust; each must lock capital and complete real trades, while failed delivery forfeits the bond. Whether selling a jetty blueprint, a sonnet, or marble, the attacker pays up front and risks losing funds for every fabricated identity.
